// about: The behavior prefabs of mission scripts (milestone M6a, section 8 of the M6a design, decision D524). The matcher runs the beat prefabs in their order, and the core triggers of one prefab in file order. A trigger is a member of at most one instance. Core matches are data. Member rules and the checks of the steps are a fixed set of functions in MissionPrefabs.cs. The write rule of a field (milestone M6b-3, section 5.8 of the M6b design) tells which lines a field of a matched instance writes. The rules are value (a value of an action), condition, key (a value of a key of the core section) and lines. A field without a write rule shows structure and is read-only. The templates of the prefabs are in Prefabs/<id>.ini. The files hold no retail name.

help.title: Checkpoint
help.whatItIs: A save point, and the trigger that rebuilds the scene after a load.
help.whatItWrites: An Act_Save line and the [Trigger] section that it names.

fields.label: Saves at
fields.help: The trigger with the save line. The game saves the mission when this trigger runs.

fields.label: Restores with
fields.help: The trigger where the mission continues after a load.

fields.label: Restore waits for
fields.help: The event that the restore trigger waits for after a load.

steps.name: Restore trigger
steps.reason: After a load, the mission continues at this trigger.

steps.name: Scene rebuild
steps.reason: After a load, the scene is empty until a trigger rebuilds it.

help.title: Offer mission
help.whatItIs: A mission offer in a bar: the offer scene, and what happens when the player accepts or declines.
help.whatItWrites: Act_AddRTC lines and [Trigger] sections with Cnd_MsnResponse.

fields.label: Offer scene
fields.help: The base scenes that show the offer to the player.

fields.label: On accept
fields.help: The trigger that runs when the player accepts the mission.

fields.label: On decline
fields.help: The triggers that run when the player declines the mission.

steps.name: Offer scene
steps.reason: The player sees the offer in this scene.

steps.name: Accept trigger
steps.reason: Without it, nothing happens when the player accepts.

steps.name: Decline trigger
steps.reason: Without it, the player cannot get the offer again after a decline.

help.title: Play space cutscene
help.whatItIs: A space cutscene: the trigger that starts it on an anchor ship, and the trigger that gives the camera back.
help.whatItWrites: An Act_CallThorn line and a later Act_RevertCam line.

fields.label: Cutscene file
fields.help: The space cutscene that the trigger plays.

fields.label: Anchor
fields.help: The ship that the camera of the cutscene moves with. Without it, the anchor is the player.

fields.label: Ends when
fields.help: The event that the trigger with "End camera" waits for.

fields.label: Camera back
fields.help: The trigger that gives the camera back to the player.

steps.name: Cutscene file
steps.reason: The game plays nothing without the file.

steps.name: Anchor
steps.reason: The camera of the cutscene moves with the anchor ship.

steps.name: Camera back
steps.reason: Without "End camera", the camera does not come back to the player.

help.title: Branch
help.whatItIs: An if and an else on the state of a trigger. Some watchers run when the trigger is active. The others run when it is not active.
help.whatItWrites: [Trigger] sections with Cnd_WatchTrigger, ON and OFF.

fields.label: Tests trigger
fields.help: The trigger whose state the watchers test.

fields.label: If it is active
fields.help: The watchers that run when the tested trigger is active.

fields.label: If it is not active
fields.help: The watchers that run when the tested trigger is not active.

steps.name: Watchers stop each other
steps.reason: Without it, both paths can run one after the other.

help.title: Ambush
help.whatItIs: Attackers that the mission spawns at a time or a place, and the reaction when they come.
help.whatItWrites: A [MsnRandEnc] section, Act_EnableEnc lines and a [Trigger] section with Cnd_EncLaunched.

fields.label: Encounter
fields.help: The random encounter that spawns the attackers.

fields.label: Attackers
fields.help: The faction of the attackers.

fields.label: Starts by
fields.help: When the attackers spawn: after a time, or when the target comes near a point.

fields.label: Armed by
fields.help: The triggers that arm the encounter. The encounter spawns only while a trigger arms it.

fields.label: On spawn
fields.help: The triggers that run when the attackers spawn.

steps.name: Armed by a trigger
steps.reason: The encounter never spawns until a trigger arms it.

steps.name: Reaction trigger
steps.reason: Without it, the attackers keep the attitudes of their faction.

help.title: Spawn wave
help.whatItIs: A group of ships that spawns and gets orders and sides, and the triggers that wait until the ships are destroyed.
help.whatItWrites: A [Trigger] section with spawn lines, and [Trigger] sections with Cnd_Destroyed.

fields.label: Ships
fields.help: The ships and formations that the trigger spawns, one row for each spawn line.

fields.label: Spawn when
fields.help: The event that the spawn trigger waits for.

fields.label: Orders
fields.help: The order lists that the trigger gives to the ships.

fields.label: Sides
fields.help: The attitude lines of the spawn trigger. They set which ships the new ships fight.

fields.label: Ends when
fields.help: The triggers that wait until the ships are destroyed.

steps.name: Ships to spawn
steps.reason: A spawn of a missing name spawns nothing.

steps.name: Sides
steps.reason: Without attitude lines, the ships keep the attitudes of their faction.

steps.name: End trigger
steps.reason: Without it, nothing happens after the ships are destroyed.

help.title: Destroy targets
help.whatItIs: Objects that the player must destroy. Marks show them on the screen. A trigger waits until they are destroyed.
help.whatItWrites: Act_MarkObj lines and [Trigger] sections with Cnd_Destroyed.

fields.label: Targets
fields.help: The objects that the trigger marks for the player.

fields.label: Done when
fields.help: The triggers that wait until the targets are destroyed.

steps.name: Targets marked
steps.reason: The player finds the targets by their marks.

steps.name: Done trigger
steps.reason: Without it, nothing happens after the targets are destroyed.

help.title: Conversation
help.whatItIs: A chain of comm lines. Each line waits for the line before it.
help.whatItWrites: A chain of [Trigger] sections with comm lines and Cnd_CommComplete.

fields.label: Lines
fields.help: The comm lines of the chain, in order. Each trigger waits for the line before it.

fields.label: Starts when
fields.help: The event that the first trigger of the chain waits for.

steps.name: Comm lines exist
steps.reason: The game plays no sound for a missing comm line.

help.title: Mission success
help.whatItIs: The end of the mission with success: the reward, the reputation changes, the log text and the end scene.

fields.label: Reward
fields.help: The money that the player gets.

fields.label: Reputation changes
fields.help: The reputation changes of the success.

fields.label: Log text
fields.help: The log texts that the success adds.

fields.label: End scene
fields.help: The base scene that the success adds.

help.title: Mission fail
help.whatItIs: The end of the mission with fail, and the text that tells the player why.
help.whatItWrites: A [Trigger] section with Act_ChangeState = FAIL and a text id.

fields.label: Fail text
fields.help: The text that tells the player why the mission failed.

steps.name: Fail text
steps.reason: The game shows this text when the mission fails.

help.title: Keep applying
help.whatItIs: A rule that the game applies again and again while the trigger is active, for example "always friendly".
help.whatItWrites: A [Trigger] section with repeatable = true and Cnd_True.

fields.label: Applies
fields.help: The actions that the game runs again at each update while the trigger is active.

help.title: Set reputation
help.whatItIs: A trigger that only changes attitudes and reputations.
help.whatItWrites: A [Trigger] section with Act_SetVibe or Act_SetRep lines.

fields.label: Attitudes
fields.help: The attitude lines of the trigger.

fields.label: Reputation
fields.help: The reputation lines of the trigger.

help.title: Lock or unlock gate
help.whatItIs: A trigger that only locks or unlocks docks and gates, for the player or for other ships.

fields.label: Docks
fields.help: The docks, gates and jump holes that the trigger locks or unlocks.

help.title: Objective
help.whatItIs: A trigger that only sets the objective and its texts.
help.whatItWrites: A [Trigger] section with objective and text lines.

fields.label: Objective
fields.help: The objective that the trigger sets.

fields.label: State
fields.help: The state that the trigger gives to the objective.

fields.label: Title
fields.help: The mission title that the trigger sets.

fields.label: Log text
fields.help: The log texts that the trigger adds.

help.title: Watched state
help.whatItIs: A trigger with a condition and no actions. Other triggers watch its state.
help.whatItWrites: A [Trigger] section with one Cnd_ line and no Act_ lines.

fields.label: Waits for
fields.help: The event that the trigger waits for. Other triggers watch if it is active or has run.

help.title: Escort
help.whatItIs: Orders that make a ship follow the player or another ship.
help.whatItWrites: An [ObjList] section with a Follow or FollowPlayer line.

fields.label: Follows
fields.help: The ship that the escort follows.

fields.label: Distance
fields.help: The distance in meters that the escort keeps from the ship that it follows.

help.title: Patrol
help.whatItIs: Orders that make a ship fly along two or more points.
help.whatItWrites: An [ObjList] section with GotoVec or GotoSpline lines.

fields.label: Waypoints
fields.help: The points that the ship flies to, in order.
